html_bullets.point: Tata Power is set to announce its Q4FY25 results today, with shares having increased by over 1.3% prior to the results release.

Tata Power's revenues are projected to grow by 5% to Rs 17,107 crore for Q4FY25, with net profit expected to remain flat at Rs 903 crore, supported by its renewable energy portfolio and contained losses at Mundra.
Tata Power is scheduled to release its Q4FY25 earnings report today, May 14.
Tata Power has established a robust charging infrastructure to support the growing demand for electric vehicles, providing home, community, and public charging solutions.
